reasoning: In mid-March in Limoges, France, temperatures are generally warming as spring approaches. March 22 is one week after March 15, so climatologically we'd expect slightly warmer average temperatures later in the month. However, day-to-day weather variability is substantial and can easily override the small seasonal trend (~0.2-0.3°C per week). Given the modest upward seasonal trend but significant daily variability, the probability that March 22 is warmer than March 15 is slightly above 50%, perhaps around 52-55%.
